config firewall schedule recurring
    edit "always"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005
        set day sunday monday tuesday wednesday thursday friday saturday
    next
    edit "none"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006
    next
    edit "default-darrp-optimize"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007
        set start 01:00
        set end 01:30
        set day sunday monday tuesday wednesday thursday friday saturday
    next
end
